preconditions.description: The lengths of strings s and t are between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in t)
preconditions.description: String t consists only of lowercase Latin letters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz*' for c in s) and s.count('*') <= 1
preconditions.description: String s consists of lowercase Latin letters and at most one wildcard character '*'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if (s.replace('*', '') in t or (s.count('*') == 1 and (t.startswith(s.split('*')[0]) and t.endswith(s.split('*')[1])))) else 'NO'
postconditions.description: Output 'YES' if t matches s by replacing the wildcard '*' with any sequence of lowercase letters (including empty), otherwise output 'NO'.
